deepseek-peak-hours.config.peakHoursShow: Show a separate status-bar item for DeepSeek peak/off-peak hours (UTC, Monday-Friday).
deepseek-peak-hours.config.peakHoursDebu: Write simulated time, interval changes, state transitions, and notifications to the Extension Host log.
Debug UTC time for peak hours
For debugging only. Sets the simulated UTC start time; elapsed real time advances from it.
deepseek-peak-hours.config.peakSoonMinut: Minutes before peak starts to show Peak soon (0-60).
deepseek-peak-hours.config.boundaryRefre: Minutes before and after each peak transition to check every 30 seconds (0-60).
deepseek-peak-hours.config.peakTransitio: Minutes to turn Peak on before its start (0-60).
deepseek-peak-hours.config.postPeakMinut: Minutes after peak ends to keep the status in the yellow transition state (0-60).
